mechanism: Indomethacin may reduce renal clearance of methimazole and increase its plasma concentration; additionally, NSAIDs can increase risk of agranulocytosis when combined with methimazole.
action: Monitor for signs of methimazole toxicity and agranulocytosis (fever, sore throat, unusual bruising); consider alternative NSAID or analgesic if possible; ensure adequate monitoring of complete blood count.
